titolo: Your email, turned into what you need to do
sottotitolo: Actions, things you are waiting on and replies — each one linked to the emails it comes from.

informativa.lettura: We read and send email from your Gmail mailbox only with your permission, and store its text encrypted.
informativa.fuoriBrowser: New mail keeps being analysed while your browser is closed.
informativa.modelli: Email text is sent to AI models through OpenRouter with your own key, only to providers that keep no data.
informativa.invio: Nothing is ever sent without your explicit confirmation.
informativa.nonVerificata: During the pilot Google shows an "unverified app" screen: this is expected.
